tv.note: GDELT TV (Internet Archive TV News Archive). Checked 2026-11-02: the API rejects every Los Angeles station (KTLA, KABC, KCBS, KCAL, KNBC, KTTV: 'Invalid Station') and the market 'Los Angeles' ('Invalid Market'), so LA stations reach the tracker through the priority site searches. The per-station cap below applies the day an LA station appears in a listed market.

ethnic.note: California ethnic-media outlets (ems_ca_outlets.json, from the Ethnic Media Services directory) not already on record: OR-grouped site: searches with after_date, Southern California first, at most max_calls searches a run. A group of Korean / Chinese / Armenian / Russian / Farsi outlets also searches his name in that script. LANGCAP-v1 (2026-11-03): spellings from saved copies (work/lang_capture/SPELLINGS.md); Hebrew has no EMS outlets, so its entry only takes effect if a Hebrew group is added.

release_time.note: The office and caucus listing pages carry <time datetime=...Z> with a time of day (the page's created stamp, not an e-mail send time). Captured into the run doc, release_texts.json and the tab's Note. A midnight-UTC stamp (T00:00:00Z) is a date only and is ignored.

youtube.note: YTSTATION-v1 (Sammy 2026-11-02): station YouTube channels. Two TinyFish searches per run (include_domains youtube.com, after_date = the run's since date). A video is kept only when its channel (as shown on the video page) is a key of `channels`; every other uploader is skipped (NOBLOGS-v1: judge by outlet; a TV or radio station's own clips stay). Add a station by adding its channel name here; `outlet` should be the tracker's existing Outlet name. The channel comes from YouTube's oEmbed endpoint (author_name, author_url) fetched through fetch_content; an entry may list `handles` (the @name in author_url, without @). Handles are matched case-insensitively and only listed where known; the name match is tried first. LANGCAP-v1 (2026-11-03): + Noticias Telemundo, CA Today (NTD Television), Sky Link TV Mandarin, KBS News; names are matched after trimming (the Sky Link Cantonese oEmbed name has a trailing space). VOA Korean left out. DATEFILTER-v1: the YouTube searches keep the date filter (tested: it narrows to the window and does not suppress).
